headline: Bills QB Josh Allen earns first overtime win of career vs. Rams on MNF
summary: Josh Allen came through with his usual late-game theatrics in leading the Bills to a 37-34 overtime win against the Rams on "Monday Night Football," breaking his career-long winless streak in OT.

headline: Jim Harbaugh says he, Chargers ownership 'in this fight together' amid 0-5 start
summary: With the Chargers off to an 0-5 start for the first time since 2003, coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday that he and the team's ownership group are "shoulder to shoulder where we're in this fight together."

headline: Sean McVay: Field goal unit "cost us the game tonight"
summary: The Rams fell to 2-3 on Monday night, due in part to a couple of missed field goals from kicker Harrison Mevis — including a blocked field goal in overtime that, if good, would have won the game.
